items.title: How Will General Mills Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: General Mills (NYSE:GIS) is set to report its earnings on Tuesday, September 23, 2026. The company has $19 billion in current market capitalization. Revenue over the last twelve months was $18 billion, and it was operationally profitable with $2.7 billion in operating profits. While a lot will depend on how results stack up against consensus and expectations, understanding historical patterns might just turn the odds in your favor if you are an event-driven trader.

items.title: Hain Celestial (HAIN) Reports Q4 Loss, Tops Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Hain Celestial (HAIN) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -66.67% and +2.56%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Replace Your $6,000 Grocery Budget With Dividends Alone: The Math
items.summary: The company behind Cheerios, Pillsbury, and Blue Buffalo has paid dividends for 127 straight years, and a single calculation reveals exactly how much of its stock it takes to make your grocery bill someone else's problem.
